answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn, making that stake the kernel of its identity: peers attest to it only after watching real work across several epochs. A sybil farm must then fund one bond per fake — a ledge of frozen capital that grows linearly with the swarm it wants — while any fake caught colluding is slashed, its bond burned to an ember. Honest agents reclaim their stake; the attacker only watches capital die.
